India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement Nears Implementation

New Zealand's Trade Minister, Todd McClay, stated that the Free Trade Agreement (FTA) between India and New Zealand is likely to come into effect within a month. The agreement aims to enhance trade relations between the two nations. Specific details regarding the implementation timeline and the exact date were not provided in the coverage.
